desc: The Ace-R Upland Ultralight is attractive, stylish, and lightweight with smooth shooting inertia and comes in a 24” or 26” barrel. Weighing in at 5.3lbs for the 20ga and 6.3lbs for the 12ga, the Ace-R Upland Ultralight is the perfect choice for fast flying grouse in the northwoods or sharpies in the Dakotas. The Ace-R Upland Ultralight – love-at-first-shouldering with quality to last a lifetime.
